paragraphs.text: Martyr is an obsolete creature type and class used to represent people who suffer or die, often willingly, for their religious or political beliefs.

Martyr debuted as a creature type in Mirage on Vigilant Martyr , which appeared as a human from Dominaria dressed in robes, wielding a staff, and wearing a helmet. It could sacrifice itself to regenerate another creature or to counter spells that target enchantments . The type was later made obsolete and removed in the Grand Creature Type Update with the original card's type becoming just Cleric . The concept of a Matyr has been referenced on several planes including Amonkhet , Dominaria , Innistrad , Ixalan , and Ravnica . Most Martyr-related cards involve sacrifice or have triggers on the creature's death. Coldsnap featured a cycle of Martyrs in each color that allowed their controller to reveal cards and sacrifice them for differing effects.
